From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Kate Li <kate.li@acme.com>, cloudsec@acme.com
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 16:15:00 -0400
Subject: POC kickoff & calendar orchestration — Acme Finance Platform

Hi Alicia/Marco —

Thanks again for the time earlier this week. We'd like to lock in the POC kickoff so we can align on success criteria, timeline, and owners. To keep coordination tight (AE + SE + your engineers + procurement + security), proposed options below — please pick any that work or suggest alternatives: 

- Option A: Tue, 31 Mar — 09:00–10:30 AM ET (deep technical + environment review)
- Option B: Tue, 31 Mar — 02:00–03:30 PM ET (procurement + timeline focus included)
- Option C: Wed, 01 Apr — 11:00–12:30 PM ET (lighter tech intro, follow with SE session)

Agenda (attached: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf): goals, success criteria, environment prerequisites, access list, timeline/milestones, data/security checklist. I attached a mutual action plan and a draft SOW for procurement to review.

Owners we plan to bring: Soojin (SE, implementation owner), Vivek (runtime/ops), me for day-to-day coordination. Would love confirmation of your security contact and procurement rep so we can include them on the calendar invite.

Next steps: please confirm preferred option + any blackout dates. Once confirmed I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-kickoff checklist.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.inference] | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf (agenda, 2 pages), Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (workback), SOW_Draft.docx (draft)
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acme.com>

Subject: Re: POC kickoff & calendar orchestration — Acme Finance Platform

Jordan —

Thanks for the options. Quick note: Tue morning is blocked for our Exec offsite, and Tue afternoon conflicts with a quarterly close runbook. Can we aim for Wed 01 Apr 11:00–12:30 PM ET (Option C)? That slot looks best for engineering + procurement to join.

Security will be represented by the cloudsec alias for now; I'll follow up with a direct contact if we need an on-call engineer. Procurement (Kate) is cc’d. Also, could you add a one-page success criteria template to the invite? That helps our procurement team sign off quickly.

Alicia

Jordan
